description: Defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for QPACK instructions used in QUIC protocol implementation, including instruction encoding, decoding, and related classes.

classes.name: QpackInstructionWithValues
classes.description: Encapsulates instruction data and parameters for encoding QPACK instructions, with static factory methods for creating specific instruction instances.

methods.name: InsertWithNameReference
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for inserting a header with a name reference, specifying if static, the name index, and the value.

methods.name: InsertWithoutNameReference
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for inserting a header without a name reference, specifying the name and value.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for duplicating an entry at a given index.

methods.name: SetDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues to set the dynamic table size.

methods.name: InsertCountIncrement
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues to increment the insert count.

methods.name: HeaderAcknowledgement
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for header acknowledgement with a stream ID.

methods.name: StreamCancellation
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues to cancel a stream.

methods.name: Prefix
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for header data prefix with required insert count.

methods.name: IndexedHeaderField
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for an indexed header field, specifying if static and the index.

methods.name: LiteralHeaderFieldNameReference
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for a literal header with name reference, specifying if static, the index, and the value.

methods.name: LiteralHeaderField
methods.description: Creates a QpackInstructionWithValues for a literal header with name and value.
